title: Defense lists 4 more witnesses in Sara Duterte trial
summary: One witness will testify on legal concepts related to the Anti-Money Laundering Council, while three others will take up issues related to Calle88 Foods Corp.

blocks.text: TRIAL. Defense lead counsel Shiela Sison briefs her team during Day 43 of the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte on November 12, 2026.
One witness will testify on legal concepts related to the Anti-Money Laundering Council, while three others will take up issues related to Calle88 Foods Corp.
MANILA, Philippines – The defense counsel of Vice President Sara Duterte is expected to present four more witnesses in her ongoing impeachment trial this week.

In a manifestation dated November 13, the defense sought the issuance of subpoena ad testificandum and duces tecum to the following witnesses directing them to participate, give testimony, and provide relevant documents in the impeachment proceedings from Thursday, November 19 to Friday, November 20:

items: Lawyer Rainer Dela Fuente, who will testify on legal concepts related to the Anti-Money Laundering Act
Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) Undersecretary Ceferino Rodolfo, who will testify on Calle88 Foods Corporation’s registration with the Board of Investments (BOI)
Food and Drug Administration (FDA) Director IV Pilar Marilyn Pagayunan, who will testify on Calle88 Foods’ product registration
Center for International Expositions and Missions (CITEM) Department Manager III Rowena Mendoza, who will testify on communications between the agency and Calle88

blocks.text: The defense also wants the witnesses to identify and submit relevant documents, including Calle88’s BOI registration and FDA product registration, as well as communications and invitations exchanged between the company and DTI-CITEM concerning food expositions.

“The foregoing witnesses will provide material testimony to controvert the allegations and factual assertions against Respondent-Accused under Article II of Articles of Impeachment, and other relevant matters, as well as identify the documents relevant thereto,” the manifestation read.
Duterte is facing impeachment proceedings under Article II of the Articles of Impeachment, which involves allegations of unexplained wealth, including undeclared assets and properties.

After the prosecution rested its case, the defense began with its presentation of evidence last week, presenting witnesses to explain allegations on a forensic financial analyst’s report that the Vice President allegedly accumulated P871 million undeclared wealth, from 2022 to 2025, including income from the Davao City government.
Lead defense counsel Sheila Sison previously said the defense would present eight to ten more witnesses in the trial. – Rappler.com
